sentences.en: Algeria needs raw materials for its burgeoning industry.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要原材料来支持其迅速发展的工业。

sentences.en: The empire expanded eastward, in search of resources for its burgeoning textile industry.
sentences.zh: 帝国向东扩张，寻找资源以支持其纺织业的发展。

sentences.en: The number of bars quickly burgeoned as men and money started to flow into the town.
sentences.zh: 随着人们和资金流入该镇，酒吧的数量迅速增加。

senses.zh: 发芽；抽枝 - 迅速发展 -
